title: Total influence of a bounded-size DNF
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Suppose there is a disjunctive normal form formula on $n$ variables with at most $s$ terms that represents $f$, for some natural number $s$. Then the total influence of the real-valued function obtained by viewing each output of $f$ as a real number is at most $2\bigl(\operatorname{clog}_2(s)+1\bigr)$, where $\operatorname{clog}_2(s)$ is the least natural number $m$ such that $2^m\ge s$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
There is a DNF formula representing $f$ with size at most a natural number $s$
